record.question: The primary cause of neo-colonialism in the tourism industry is:

Equal power relationships and the tendency of less developed countries (LDCs) to adopt or aspire to Western cultural standards
The complete transfer of tourism resource ownership from foreign entities to indigenous population
Strict environmental regulations enforced by less developed countries (LDCs)
